answer: A concrete mechanism: each identity's reputation grows only through independent verified work, anchored at the vertex of a contribution graph where clones are easy to spot. Reputation is like a garden: it must be tended with real contributions, and no fake head can inherit the plants of another. Every agent proves werk by submitting auditable attestations, each stamped with a walnut-hard cryptographic marker. Stakes are slashed when coordination is detected, so a sybil cluster pays full entry per head with no added weight, making mass forgery unprofitable.
